scope: Cross-section a11y + mobile + visual stability inventory. Synthesizes the a11y rules applied in each section and the responsive breakpoints baked into each per-section CSS bundle.

iframes_have_title.rule: every <iframe> in templates/studio_os/ carries a title= attribute

focus_visible_outline.rule: shared rail rule preserves :focus-visible with outline (not just color)

status_badges_have_text_or_aria_label.rule: color is never the sole signal — badges include text content OR aria-label

semantic_heading_order.rule: h2/h3 in semantic order; no h4 jump without h3

destructive_actions_named_explicitly.rule: destructive button accessible names disambiguate ('Roll back to version X' not 'Roll back')

keyboard_focus.rule: all interactive elements keyboard-focusable; rail items <a> with aria-current='page' when active

overview.container_queries: mode-grid + triptych use container queries — reflow based on workspace_main width not viewport

automation.internal_scroll: .rmc-automation-graph-scroll allows horizontal scroll on wide graphs (overflow-x:auto; overflow-y:visible — NOT hidden)

breakpoints: 390 (mobile tabs surface; rail hidden via d-lg-block)
output.passthrough_wrapper: .rmc-output-passthrough (min-width:0; overflow-x:auto) wraps inner partials so wide tables internal-scroll without breaking workspace_main

mobile_first_invariants.long_labels_wrap: overflow-wrap:anywhere + word-break:break-word on shared rail rule + all per-section rail link classes
mobile_first_invariants.no_horizontal_overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth <= 1px asserted by tests/e2e/studio-os.spec.js per viewport per section
mobile_first_invariants.tables_responsive: .table-responsive or .rmc-*-scroll wrapper around every table-heavy partial

color_contrast_and_token_safety.rule: every color uses var(--*) semantic tokens — no off-token literals
color_contrast_and_token_safety.wcag_grade_target: AA 4.5:1 for all interactive text on background

honest_deferrals: Live screen-reader sweep (NVDA / VoiceOver / TalkBack) — operator action on dev environment
Live Playwright run at 1440/1536/1920px (spec covers them conceptually; spec executed at 390/768/1366 in scripted run)
